Key points
• Understand the basis of inborn errors of metabolism
• The key clinical features of disorders due to an enzyme deﬁciency in the catabolic pathways of:
• carbohydrates
• proteins
• fatty acids
• essential vitamins and cofactors
• Understand the pathology of disorders
• accumulation of toxic intermediates
• depletion of end products/energy
